svg.title: Urmit URL Shortener AWS Architecture
svg.desc: A left-to-right architecture diagram using official AWS service icons. Browser traffic passes through external DNS and CloudFront. CloudFront routes website paths to private S3 and API requests through API Gateway and Lambda to DynamoDB. CloudWatch receives logs.
svg.text: AWS serverless architecture · Static React SPA + URL API
Lambda + DynamoDB: us-east-1 · ACM certificate: us-east-1
Terraform provisions the stack. Scripts build and deploy Lambda packages, then publish frontend assets to S3.
CloudFront serves the site and short paths; API Gateway handles shortening and redirect lookups.
